jd:
Tidewater Health is a private healthcare group operating hospitals and clinics in Singapore. Our Digital Care programme is modernising how patients book, consult and manage their care, and we are hiring a Program Manager to coordinate its delivery.

Responsibilities
- Plan and run a portfolio of digital projects including patient app releases, telehealth expansion and clinic system integrations.
- Build and maintain integrated plans, budgets, risk registers and status reporting for the steering committee.
- Coordinate engineering teams, clinical leaders, vendors and compliance stakeholders to keep delivery on track.
- Manage third-party vendor contracts, deliverables and performance.
- Ensure projects comply with PDPA and healthcare regulatory requirements.
- Facilitate agile ceremonies and introduce lightweight governance that teams actually follow.
- Escalate issues early and drive them to resolution with senior stakeholders, and keep a clear decision log so that the steering committee can see what was agreed, by whom and why.
- Measure programme outcomes: adoption, patient satisfaction and cost to serve.

Requirements
- 6+ years of experience in programme, project or product delivery, with at least three years in a regulated sector.
- Proven record of delivering complex, multi-stakeholder technology projects on time and on budget.
- Experience managing vendors and budgets above $1M.
- Strong knowledge of Jira, agile and traditional planning methods; PMP or equivalent is an advantage.
- Excellent communication with clinicians, executives and engineers.
- Healthcare experience is a plus but not required.
- Singapore-based, with the right to work here.

What we offer
Meaningful work improving patient experience, stable leadership and a collaborative multidisciplinary team.

points.overrideText: Co-led the driver app relaunch with a 20-person delivery team across two vendors, keeping scope, budget and release dates on track
